description: Na₂AsTe₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Te atoms to form distorted NaTe₆ octahedra that share corners with seven NaTe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one AsNaTe₂As tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent AsNaTe₂As trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one AsNaTe₂As tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaTe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-44°. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.17-3.62 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Te atoms to form NaTe₆ octahedra that share corners with seven NaTe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent AsNaTe₂As tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent AsNaTe₂As trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one AsNaTe₂As trigonal pyramid, and faces with two equivalent NaTe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-44°. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.22-3.43 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five Te atoms. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.22-3.68 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to two As and four Te atoms. There is one shorter (3.09 Å) and one longer (3.11 Å) Na-As bond length. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.17-3.41 Å. There are two inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded to one Na, one As, and two Te atoms to form distorted AsNaTe₂As trigonal pyramids that share corners with five NaTe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one TeNa₆As pentagonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent TeNa₅As pentagonal pyramids,  a cornercorner with one AsNaTe₂As tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaTe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 72-95°. The As-As bond length is 2.53 Å. There is one shorter (2.62 Å) and one longer (2.63 Å) As-Te bond length. In the second As site, As is bonded to one Na, one As, and two Te atoms to form distorted AsNaTe₂As tetrahedra that share corners with three NaTe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent TeNa₆As pentagonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one TeNa₅As pentagonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one AsNaTe₂As trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaTe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 76-99°. There is one shorter (2.62 Å) and one longer (2.65 Å) As-Te bond length. There are four inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded to six Na and one As atom to form TeNa₆As pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent TeNa₅As pentagonal pyramids, corners with two equivalent AsNaTe₂As tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one AsNaTe₂As trigonal pyramid, edges with two equivalent TeNa₆As pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with three equivalent TeNa₅As pentagonal pyramids. In the second Te site, Te is bonded to five Na and one As atom to form distorted TeNa₅As pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent TeNa₆As pentagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent TeNa₅As pentagonal pyramids,  a cornercorner with one AsNaTe₂As tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent AsNaTe₂As trigonal pyramids, and edges with three equivalent TeNa₆As pentagonal bipyramids. In the third Te site, Te is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one As atom. In the fourth Te site, Te is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one As atom.
